title: About Tag Management for Application Segments

blocks.text: Tag Management allows you to add metadata to resources, which enables you to define keys and values and associate them with resources. Tag Management involves creating namespaces and tags to classify and group resources in Private Access (ZPA). You can use the tags to organize and list resources based on your business needs. After you create namespaces and tags, you can add them to your defined application segments.
Tag Management provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Group and manage app segments using tags.
Collect metadata for app segments with tags.

blocks.text: On the Tag Management page (Policies > Access Control > Private Applications > Tag Management), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Create a namepsace and add custom tags.
Predefined namespaces cannot be edited or deleted.
Filter tags by origin or status.
Select multiple tags to update their status.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Predefined tags cannot be edited or deleted.
